title: Living reptilians from a crash were shot

tellings.quote: >> Do you know what supposedly happened to those living reptilians from the crash? >> Uh uh deceased. They were killed.

plain: Living reptile-like beings were taken from a crashed craft and then killed, according to an unnamed speaker in a clip played on the show. The speaker passes this on from someone else, and when asked what happened to the living reptilians from the crash, answers that they were deceased: "They were killed." If true, it would mean live non-human beings were recovered and deliberately put to death.
